labelPolicy: Every label records how it was produced (constructed | observed-controlled-variation | author-judgment) and its review status. No label is human-reviewed yet: a person must review a case and set review.status to "human-reviewed" with reviewer and date. Reports count reviewed and pending labels separately.

changelog.changes: Phase 2: 15 planning cases, 10 generation cases, 8 labelled report tests.

Phase 3: label provenance and review status; 6 planning cases (multiple criteria, input validation, conflicting, untestable); 9 assertion-quality cases; 4 seeded-defect functional suites (29 reference outcomes); 10 more real failure captures; failure taxonomy aligned with the Phase 3 categories.
Naming only: description no longer names a product. Recorded captures in failures/ keep their original paths and annotations as historical evidence. No case, label or expectation changed.

API and combined cases: 4 planning (PL-22..25), 12 generation (GE-20..31) with API required assertions and intent labels; notes-app functional suites FS-NOTESAPI and FS-NOTESUI with seeded defects D-NOTES-CREATE, D-NOTES-AUTHZ, D-NOTES-TITLELEN and the renamed-add-button drift variant; 15 healing cases (healing.json); real failure captures from the example app.

Label review follow-up (docs/PHASE3_LABEL_REVIEW.md), no reference outcome changed and no label marked human-reviewed: provenance method author-judgment -> constructed for PL-07, PL-08, PL-09, PL-11, PL-12, PL-13, PL-15 and GE-02..GE-09; FS-NOTESAPI suite note reworded to match execution evidence (SC-05 is caught via the cleanup fixture, not missed); relevance policy for defects on a test's execution path recorded on FS-NOTESAPI and FS-NOTESUI, as decided by Frank Vu. Attribution: every label author is now "Frank Vu" (the repository owner); review statuses are unchanged and still pending. Recorded captures: run paths renamed to .agent/ and the deliberately unresolvable test host renamed to agent-does-not-exist.invalid; statuses, error types and every other recorded value are unchanged.
